item.title: Blacksmith
item.description: Located near the quarry. Provide tools for mine exchange for iron and copper. Purpose: purchase or order tools, jewels or custom order.

item.description: old abandoned house at northern most part of the town. Previous owner passed away and never been own by anyone.

item.description: at west, on the highest slope of the town. Lived by lighthouse keeper, and old man in his 50’s.

item.description: Located close by to the farm. A family of 3 lived there, making a living out of wood cutting and carpentry.

item.description: A gathering place to trade various items. Always busy in the morning. name should change to fish market for unreasonable amount to fish monger.

item.title: Quarry Mine
item.description: Located a rocky terrain. Old man Jeofrey and his team do the mining for the living. also have copper and iron deposits.
